name: A Chinese junk
summary:
A drawing of a small three-masted junk off the coast, with rectangular sails set on the fore and aft masts; Chinese characters are inscribed on the foresail.
On the back is a pencil sketch of small boats in the Praya Grande, Macau; beyond are the convent and fort of S. Francisco.
